Heli Coil

A thread insert made by winding diamond cross-section stainless steel wire into a helical (coil) shape. It is inserted into a tapped hole in a soft material such as aluminum or plastic to create a strong steel thread surface, and is also used to repair tapped holes that have become loose or worn.

钢丝螺套 (Heli Coil)

将菱形截面的不锈钢丝绕制成螺旋(线圈)状而成的螺纹嵌件。插入铝、塑料等软质材料上攻丝加工的孔中，形成坚固的钢制螺纹面，也用于修复松动或磨损的螺纹孔。
